name: DocSage
shortDescription: Team knowledge base with citations, review status, version diffs and offline ranked search.
features: Pages with owners, review status (draft/in_review/published) and visibility (team/restricted)
Sources/citations per page; external URLs must be on the configured allowlist (rejected with reasons)
Offline TF-IDF keyword search with scores + snippets (labelled: not semantic embeddings)
Restricted pages absent from non-admin results (not blurred)
Version diffs + audit trail; JSON import/export with rejection reasons
knownLimitations: Demo workspace simulated; keyword search only (no embeddings)
Roles via query parameter for demo; production would use real auth
